description: Handcrafted artisan sourdough bread made with love in New Braunfels, Texas. Preorder for farmers market pickup.

preorder.cutoffText: Preorders close Thursday at 8 PM before each Saturday market.
preorder.pickupInstructions: Pick up your order at our booth at Castell Street Market. Look for the Knead & Bake TX banner!
policies: All items are baked fresh Friday evening and Saturday morning.
Preorders guarantee your loaf — walk-up availability varies.
Payment is collected at pickup (cash or card).
Cancellations accepted until Friday at noon.
Allergen info is listed per item — please review before ordering.

seo.description: Handcrafted small-batch sourdough bread at the Castell Street Market in New Braunfels, TX. Preorder online for guaranteed pickup.
